[SWS_CM_99037] Method request message separation time
Upstream requirements:
RS_SOMEIP_00051
⌈
If attribute
SomeipMethodDeployment
.
separationTimeRequest
is set, and
segmentation is activated for the corresponding SOME/IP method request message
according to [SWS_CM_10455], the segments shall be separated in time by this
value.
⌋
